name: Neural signal propagation atlas of Caenorhabditis elegans
description: Wrote custom code for handling the output of a unique microscopy rig, including an electrically tunable lens capable of acquiring images at variable (but precisely measured) depths.
Published a total of **10 TB** of C. elegans microscopy data on the associated NIH data archive.
Showcased reproduction of key figures from the associated manuscript through an interactive Jupyter Notebook.
